$comment: Schema for the LLM-maintained wiki. Page types and the frontmatter every page must carry. wiki.mjs lint enforces this.

sourceEntry.path: repo-relative path to an immutable raw source
sourceEntry.hash: sha256 of that source at last ingest (for stale detection)

layout.decisions: decision pages; link to docs/decisions ADRs

rules.everyPageCitesSources: non-home pages must cite >=1 source; claims trace to raw sources
rules.staleOnSourceChange: a page is stale (error) when a cited source's current sha256 != the recorded hash
rules.noBrokenLinks: every [[wikilink]] must resolve to an existing page
rules.noOrphans: warn when a non-home page has no inbound links
rules.linksNotDuplication: link to the source or another page rather than copying its content
